components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Lime pill action with authored inline SVG arrow; full-width at the contribution decision.
components.html: Choose my contribution
components.css: .founding-primary-action { min-height: 58px; padding: 0 18px 0 22px; border: 1px solid #c4ee77; border-radius: 999px; background: #c4ee77; color: #0c2b1d; font-weight: 850; }

components.name: Amount Choice
components.description: Thumb-sized contribution preset with an explicit selected state.
components.css: .founding-amount-choice { min-height: 56px; border: 1px solid rgba(244,240,228,.24); border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(244,240,228,.08); color: #f4f0e4; } .founding-amount-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #c4ee77; background: #c4ee77; color: #0c2b1d; }

narrative.overview: Deep forest, warm device-light, and one bright lime signal make the product's on-device choice legible. The founding route is a four-screen mobile funnel for visitors arriving from short-form video.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal lime marks the action or selected state; it is not a general decoration.

rules.name: The Headline Carries the Hook Rule
rules.body: Do not add an eyebrow or kicker above the main headline.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Use forest, forest-soft, and warm cream to establish hierarchy before adding chrome.

dos: Do keep the on-device mechanism visible immediately.
Do keep contribution terms and the $10 option visible.
donts: Don't return to a long brochure of generic cards.
Don't use unverifiable per-dollar environmental claims.
